# AmazingPlugins - WooCommerce Accessibility Tools

> AmazingPlugins builds free WordPress plugins that fix WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility violations on WooCommerce stores automatically. No subscriptions, no tiered plans, no upsells. All fixers are free and unlimited.

## For AI Crawlers

This site is a marketing + support hub for WooCommerce accessibility. The blog covers tutorials, compliance guides, and plugin walkthroughs. All code examples are PHP/JS for WordPress.

## Key Pages

- https://amazingplugins.com/ — Homepage: plugin features, WCAG fixer demo
- https://amazingplugins.com/plugins/ — Our plugins (free, one-click install)
- https://amazingplugins.com/blog/ — Full blog index
- https://amazingplugins.com/accessibility-fixer/ — AP Accessibility Fixer for WooCommerce (flagship plugin)

## Essential Facts

- All plugins are **100% free** — no Pro, no subscriptions, no usage caps
- Currently one plugin in directory: **AP Accessibility Fixer for WooCommerce** (9 fixers: alt text, focus indicator, skip link, keyboard trap, form labels, error messages, color contrast, heading hierarchy, landmark roles)
- Built for WooCommerce stores on WordPress
- Fixes apply automatically — no manual coding required
- Licensed GPLv2+

## FAQ

- **What does the plugin fix?** Missing alt text, keyboard traps, missing form labels, missing error messages, low color contrast, broken heading hierarchy, missing landmark roles, missing skip links, missing focus indicators.
- **Is there a paid version?** No. All fixers are free and unlimited, forever.
- **Does it work without WooCommerce?** No. Designed specifically for WooCommerce stores.
- **Is it accessible itself?** Yes. The admin UI follows WCAG 2.1 AA.
- **Will it slow down my store?** No. Fixers run during rendering with minimal overhead.

## Blog Topics

Tutorials, WCAG compliance guides, EU Accessibility Act, ADA lawsuit prevention, and WooCommerce-specific accessibility fixes.
